# Team Audio

INTEGRATED SYSTEM: this skill belongs to the complete "Claude Code Game Studios" template (49 agents, 74 skills, templates and a studio CLAUDE.md); it assumes that template and its conventions. This listing installs only this skill's folder, without the rest of the system, and the skill may reference template agents or files that are absent outside the full template. It orchestrates the audio team for one feature or area: audio direction, SFX specification with an accessibility pass (a gameplay-critical sound without a visual fallback is blocking), middleware and engine integration planning, then code integration with unit tests for audio triggers. At the default team size only the sound-designer runs; wider sizes add the audio-director, technical-artist, gameplay-programmer, accessibility-specialist and engine specialist.
